changes.text: Georeferenced A4 map frame in UTM (WGS84): scales 1:1000-1:15000 in steps of 500, portrait or landscape, margins, corner snap, lock, unlock and reselect the area.
Basemaps: Apple Maps Satellite, Hybrid and Standard as a saved HD image of the locked area or Live, your own GeoTIFF, one opacity control and Map data info.
ISOM 2017-2 and ISSprOM 2019-2 symbol sets (Rev. 6) with the OCAD color hierarchy, area patterns and line decorations; import and export symbol sets (.occasym, OCAD .ocd, OOM .omap / .xmap).
Vector tools like OCAD and OOM: bezier Pen, Freehand, Rectangle, Ellipse, Move Tool, Node Tool (sharp, smooth, smart points) and Measure Tool.
Shape editing: follow object, auto-join, Join / Merge, fill area, cut line, split area, scale, parallel, reverse direction and precise Shift rotation.
Multi-select with selection box, move, duplicate, delete and change the symbol of every selected object.
Apple Pencil sketching with ISOM pen presets, stroke eraser, undo and redo.
Contours from a DEM (built-in Terrain Tiles, GeoTIFF, ASCII Grid, GeoJSON) with interval, index and form lines; convert contours to map objects.
North lines grid (grid or magnetic north), labeled scale bar and frame corners in UTM, decimal degrees and DMS.
Symbol guide: the IOF omapwiki page of the active symbol in a side panel.
Course Settings page: start, controls and finish, several courses sharing controls, automatic codes, lengths, climb, competitors and checks.
Illustrated IOF 2018 control descriptions, course objects (text, shapes, images, IOF course symbols 702-715) and one-page race maps with an All controls master map.
Import courses from OCCA projects, OCAD course setting files and OOM maps.
Field panel: GPS position, field notes with photos and photo markup, position averaging, bearing and distance offset, quick vegetation notes and external GNSS receivers.
Track recording on iPad Wi-Fi + Cellular, field mode with big buttons and touch lock, and a Ready check before going out.
GPX import and export, track to line, survey coverage and a field report PDF.
Field data between devices with .occafield files: only new tracks and notes are added, desk work is kept.
.occa project files that open on both iPad and Mac (Files, Finder, AirDrop).
Import OCAD 10-2018 (.ocd) and OOM (.omap / .xmap) maps into a project or as a new project.
Export PNG / TIFF / JPEG with world file, georeferenced PDF, OOM .omap, DXF, IOF XML 3.0 and contours to Shapefile / KML / KMZ, optionally with the basemap underneath.
iPad and Mac with the same features and a layout for each device: touch and Apple Pencil on iPad, mouse, trackpad and keyboard shortcuts on Mac.
Project list with previews, search and sort; splash screen; short guide for new users; light, dark or system appearance.
License keys from Jendela Cakra Digital: a Mac key (OC31-OC34) activates on a Mac and an iPad key (OC52-OC54) on an iPad; works offline for up to 30 days between checks.
Starter on Mac (up to 3 projects at 1:4000 or 1:10000, up to 4 courses) and view-only projects on iPad without a license; a small STARTER / TRIAL label on Starter and Trial.
